title: Izolacija (multi-tenancy, gVisor) i enkripcija Pod-Pod
summary: Izolacija tenanta u istom klasteru (namespace, RBAC, NetworkPolicy, kvote, posvećeni čvorovi), sandbox kontejneri preko RuntimeClass-a i gVisora te šifrovanje saobraćaja između Podova sa Cilium WireGuard/IPsec i Istio mTLS-om.
summary_en: Tenant isolation within one cluster (namespaces, RBAC, NetworkPolicy, quotas, dedicated nodes), sandboxed containers via RuntimeClass and gVisor, and encrypting Pod-to-Pod traffic with Cilium WireGuard/IPsec and Istio mTLS.
